svg.title: A typical AI control plane: logical responsibilities
svg.desc: Management handles inventory, lifecycle, policy configuration, authority and containment intent. Local and shared decision-support services provide identity, policy evaluation, approvals, run state, budgets and containment state. Gates, runtime hooks and external gateways enforce decisions. Required evidence writers, linked outcomes and independent reconciliation support assurance. Developers, business teams and AI agents receive no implicit trust. Zero trust applies across the architecture: network location does not itself grant access; verify identity and authority and grant only required access. These are logical roles, not a single central service or a sequence followed by every request.
svg.text: No implicit trust for developers, users, business teams or AI agents
Verify identity and authority; grant only the access needed

g.text: Decision support: local and shared services, used as required
Trusted facts, decisions and required steps
Enforcement: the code that can allow, hold or stop work
Link what was decided to what happened
